Only the two 3-fold rows are matched arms (the same patients,
folds and inner splits, differing only in how the modules are
defined), so rebuilding costs +0.0003 for disease-specific
survival and +0.0020 for overall survival. For disease-specific
survival both 3-fold rows (+0.0129 fixed, +0.0126 rebuilt) sit
below the 10 x 10 value (+0.0227), which the matched fixed-module
arm attributes to the coarser cross-validation rather than to
module definition. Ranges span 5 fold assignments and are not
confidence intervals; every row carries its own n
